say:0:1321302001:0.text: Why is Madam Gerda staring at the hot spring like that?
say:0:1321302001:0.source_cn: 哎？格尔达女士怎么在对着温泉发呆？

say:3:1321303001:1.text: Madam Gerda, is something wrong? You've been staring at the hot spring for quite a while. Is there something wrong with the water?
say:3:1321303001:1.source_cn: 老板娘，你遇到什么棘手的事了吗？满满看你一直盯着温泉发...

say:4:1321303002:1.text: Hmm? Oh no, the hot spring's just fine! The Frozen Paw's spring water flows straight from deep underground, so the quality and temperature are perfectly fine. I was just thinking about some... business matters.
say:4:1321303002:1.source_cn: 啊，不是的。白熊旅店的温泉水来源于地下，不用担心水质和...

say:5:1321303003:1.text: Is the inn not doing well?!
say:5:1321303003:1.source_cn: 旅店的经营状况不好吗？

say:6:1321303004:1.text: Haha, not in the slightest! With all the travelers pouring into Cedartown, we're busier than ever.
say:6:1321303004:1.source_cn: 哈哈，最近雪松镇来了这么多游客，怎么可能不好？

say:7:1321303005:1.text: If anything, I've got the opposite problem—we're running short on ingredients for our famous dishes!
say:7:1321303005:1.source_cn: 刚好相反，就是因为客人太多，才导致了现在的食材短缺问题。

say:8:1321303006:1.text: Oh no! Does that mean everyone's going hungry?!
say:8:1321303006:1.source_cn: 食材短缺……？！那大家岂不是都要饿肚子？！

say:9:1321303007:1.text: Oh, darling, nothing so dramatic! The basics are covered. It's just that some of the rarer ingredients are out of stock, so we've had to tweak the menu a little. But don't worry, no one's going to starve!
say:9:1321303007:1.source_cn: 只是一部分产量稀少的食材暂时买不到，不少本地经典菜肴没...

say:10:1321303008:1.text: But it got me wondering... What if I could raise fish right here in the hot spring? It might help with the ingredient shortage.
say:10:1321303008:1.source_cn: 我刚才在想，温泉里能不能养鱼呢？要是可以的话，应该能暂...

say:11:1321303009:1.text: You guys are adventurers, aren't you? Ever heard of such a thing?
say:11:1321303009:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们见多识广，有没有见过或者听说过类似的事？

choice_prompt:12:1321303009.text: You guys are adventurers, aren't you? Ever heard of such a thing?
choice_prompt:12:1321303009.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们见多识广，有没有见过或者听说过类似的事？

say:13:1321303010:1.text: I've never heard of any fish living in hot springs before...
say:13:1321303010:1.source_cn: 我也没听说过类似的事……

say:14:1321303013:1.text: Anyway, let's give it a try! There's a good chance some fish could adapt. Warmer water might even be better for them.
say:14:1321303013:1.source_cn: 总之可以试试看！温泉的水温也没有太高，应该有不少鱼都可...

say:15:1321303014:1.source_cn: 那太好了！既然你们都这样说，看来的确有一定的可行性呢。

say:16:1321303015:1.text: Well then, sweetheart, how about lending me a hand? If you could catch a few live fish—maybe <style="highlight">two types</style>, one from <style="highlight">icy waters</style> and one from somewhere <style="highlight">warmer</style>—I'd be ever so grateful.
say:16:1321303015:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们方不方便帮我抓一些活鱼或者活虾？最好能从<...

say:17:1321303016:1.text: And if one of them thrives in the spring, I'll whip up a special Cedartown delicacy just for you. What do you say?
say:17:1321303016:1.source_cn: 作为回报，如果能找到适合养在温泉里的鱼，我就用它做一道...

say:18:1321303017:1.text:
A Cedartown delicacy?!
Say no more, just leave it to Sir Chippy!
say:18:1321303017:1.source_cn: 美食——！！\n没问题，满满一定完成任务！

say:21:1321303011:1.text: Oh, maybe! Tropical fish thrive in warmer waters. They might adapt to the hot spring environment.
say:21:1321303011:1.source_cn: 嗯，大部分热带鱼都喜欢温暖的水域，应该也能待在温泉里。

say:22:1321303012:1.text: Not necessarily! Glacial fish are used to cold water, but that doesn't mean they can't handle warmer conditions.
say:22:1321303012:1.source_cn: 不一定哦。冰河鱼只是适应了寒冷的水温，但不代表它们只能...

choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 冰河里的鱼肯定不行吧……

say:0:1321304001:0.text: We've caught four different kinds of fish! Let's head back.
say:0:1321304001:0.source_cn: 总算钓到四种不同的鱼了！现在就回去交给格尔达女士吧！

say:0:1321305001:0.text: Madam Gerda, we've got the fish you asked for!
say:0:1321305001:0.source_cn: 老板娘，我们把你要的鱼抓回来了！

say:1:1321305002:0.text: Quick, put them in the hot spring! They won't survive long out of water.
say:1:1321305002:0.source_cn: 快把它们放进温泉里吧！它们可不能缺水太久。

say:0:1321306001:0.text: Do you have a moment? I might have another favor to ask.
say:0:1321306001:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，现在有空吗？或许还有件事要麻烦你们。

say:2:1321307001:1.text: These fish seem to be doing well! It's so delightful to see them swimming happily. I have a good feeling about this! It might really help the Frozen Paw. My instincts are rarely wrong, you know!
say:2:1321307001:1.source_cn: 这些小家伙放到温泉里还是活蹦乱跳的，看着让人高兴！我有...

say:3:1321307002:1.text: They seem to be adapting well so far!
say:3:1321307002:1.source_cn: 是啊，它们暂时都没出现不适应环境的情况，真是件好事！

say:6:1321307003:1.text: However, it'll take time to see which species adapts the best.
say:6:1321307003:1.source_cn: 不过，具体哪几种才更适合在温泉中饲养，恐怕得观察一阵子...

say:7:1321307004:1.text: I'll stay here to monitor them carefully, so there's no need to worry.
say:7:1321307004:1.source_cn: 放心吧，亲爱的。我本来就打算留在这里观察它们的，不用担...

say:8:1321307005:1.text: However, that means I can't make my usual trip to Cedartown. Sweetheart, could I trouble you again?
say:8:1321307005:1.source_cn: 不过这样一来，我就抽不出时间去雪松镇了。

say:9:1321307006:1.text: There's a merchant named <style="highlight">Varon</style> on the <style="highlight">west side of town</style>. He handles my supplies, but his latest delivery is running two days late. Could you check in on him for me?

say:10:1321307007:1.text: If the delay drags on, we really might run out of food for the guests.
say:10:1321307007:1.source_cn: 要是再晚两三天，白熊旅店就真没食物招待客人了。这可是很...

say:13:1321307008:1.text: That won't do! Chippy's still waiting for Madam Gerda's special meal!
say:13:1321307008:1.source_cn: 那可不行！满满还等着吃格尔达女士做的美食呢！

say:14:1321307009:1.text: Magister! For the sake of food, let's head out!
say:14:1321307009:1.source_cn: 主人，为了美食！再次出发吧！
say:14:1321307009:1.male: Magister! For the sake of food, let's head out!
say:14:1321307009:1.female: Magister! For the sake of food, let's head out!

say:0:1321310001:0.text: A merchant... Do you think that's Varon?
say:0:1321310001:0.source_cn: 店铺开在镇子西边的商人……应该就是前面那位。

say:2:1321311001:1.text: Hello! You're Varon, right? Madam Gerda sent us.
say:2:1321311001:1.source_cn: 你就是瓦迪姆吧？是格尔达女士让我们来——

say:3:1321311002:1.text: Oh, Dura above! Please, I swear I didn't mean to delay the delivery!
say:3:1321311002:1.source_cn: ——噢，女神在上！我绝对没有故意拖着不肯交货！！

say:4:1321311003:1.text: There's been a terrible shortage of ingredients, and the Frozen Paw ordered so much. I've had to send workers all over to gather supplies. I promise it wasn't intentional!
say:4:1321311003:1.source_cn: 都是因为最近食材短缺得太厉害，白熊旅店的订货量又大，我...

say:5:1321311004:1.text: Look, the ingredients Madam Gerda ordered are almost ready, I'm just about to send someone to deliver them!
say:5:1321311004:1.source_cn: 这不，格尔达女士订的食材都差不多备齐了，我正准备派人送...

choice_prompt:6:1321311004.text: Look, the ingredients Madam Gerda ordered are almost ready, I'm just about to send someone to deliver them!
choice_prompt:6:1321311004.source_cn: 这不，格尔达女士订的食材都差不多备齐了，我正准备派人送去白熊旅店呢！

say:7:1321311005:1.text: Ah, I'm just afraid of her being mad. Madam Gerda is an old customer, and I wouldn't want to offend her.
say:7:1321311005:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我这不是怕格尔达女士生气吗？再怎么说也是老客户了...

say:8:1321311006:1.text: Plus, her hammer is quite terrifying...
say:8:1321311006:1.source_cn: 再说了，格尔达女士的锤子可不是吃素的……

say:9:1321311007:1.text: Don't worry, she's not mad! But you need to hurry, the inn has lots of hungry guests waiting!
say:9:1321311007:1.source_cn: 放心吧，格尔达女士没有生气！不过你还是早点把货送过去吧...

say:10:1321311008:1.text: I know, I know! Most of the order is ready, but... there's still one ingredient missing: <style="highlight">misted beanberry</style>.

say:13:1321311010:1.source_cn: 为什么？这种果子很稀少吗？

say:14:1321311011:1.text: It is somewhat rare, but that's not the main issue. It grows in a <style="highlight">grove north of Cedartown</style>, and that's where we usually gather it.
say:14:1321311011:1.source_cn: 确实不多，但好在只是调味品，原本需求量不大。<styl...

say:15:1321311012:1.text: Lately, some strange birds have taken over that grove and attack anyone who gets close. They've been scaring off all my workers!
say:15:1321311012:1.source_cn: 只不过……最近那附近出现了一群奇怪的鸟，一看到人就疯狂...

say:16:1321311013:1.text: Are misted beanberries really that important? Can't you substitute it with something else?
say:16:1321311013:1.source_cn: 粉面豆果很重要吗？如果能用其他东西替代，少一点也没关系吧。

say:17:1321311014:1.text: Unfortunately, no. When crushed, it releases a unique aroma that's essential for several dishes.
say:17:1321311014:1.source_cn: 恐怕没办法替代。将这种果子碾碎，在做菜时加入，会散发出...

say:20:1321311015:1.text:
Then we can't just wait around!
Magister, let's go pick some ourselves!
say:20:1321311015:1.source_cn: 那更不能这样干等着了！\n主人，我们去采一些回来吧！
say:20:1321311015:1.male:
Then we can't just wait around!
Magister, let's go pick some ourselves!
say:20:1321311015:1.female:
Then we can't just wait around!
Magister, let's go pick some ourselves!

choice_prompt:21:1321311015.text:
Then we can't just wait around!
Magister, let's go pick some ourselves!
choice_prompt:21:1321311015.source_cn: 那更不能这样干等着了！\n主人，我们去采一些回来吧！
choice_prompt:21:1321311015.male:
Then we can't just wait around!
Magister, let's go pick some ourselves!
choice_prompt:21:1321311015.female:
Then we can't just wait around!
Magister, let's go pick some ourselves!

say:22:1321311016:1.text: We'll pick ALL the misted beanberries!!!
say:22:1321311016:1.source_cn: 那我们现在就出发吧！快去快回！

choice:21:1:2.text: Let's go! In pursuit of food!
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 好吧，看在格尔达的美食的份上
choice:21:1:2.male: Let's go! In pursuit of food!
choice:21:1:2.female: Let's go! In pursuit of food!

say:24:1321311009:1.text: Y-yes... The <style="highlight">misted beanberry</style> is the only thing left, but it's going to take a little longer...

say:0:1321312001:0.text: The birds are eating all the fruit! Let's stop them!
say:0:1321312001:0.source_cn: 果然有好多鸟在吃果子！得快点阻止它们！

say:0:1321313001:0.text: What a mess... These bushes are almost picked clean.
say:0:1321313001:0.source_cn: 真是一片狼藉……这些灌木都快被啃秃了。

say:1:1321313002:0.text: I see some untouched fruits nearby. Let's pick them and go back.
say:1:1321313002:0.source_cn: 幸好周围有一些没遭殃的果子，采一些回去就好。
say:1:1321313002:0.male: I see some untouched fruits nearby. Let's pick them and go back.
say:1:1321313002:0.female: I see some untouched fruits nearby. Let's pick them and go back.

say:0:1321314001:0.text: That should be enough for seasoning.
say:0:1321314001:0.source_cn: 粉面豆果主要用来调味，不需要太多，这些应该足够了。

say:1:1321314002:0.text: That should be enough for seasoning.
say:1:1321314002:0.source_cn: 我们赶快把它带回商人那里吧。

say:2:1321315001:1.text: Sir, here are some misted beanberries. We scared off those pesky birds, too!
say:2:1321315001:1.source_cn: 我们采到你说的粉面豆果了！顺便赶跑了那些偷吃的坏鸟！

say:3:1321315002:1.text: You did?! That's amazing! Thank you so much!
say:3:1321315002:1.source_cn: 那可太好了，大伙总算不用为这事发愁了！谢谢各位了！

say:6:1321315003:1.text: By the way, has the Frozen Paw's supply order been delivered yet?
say:6:1321315003:1.source_cn: 咦，刚才那批要送到白熊旅店的食材呢？已经送过去了吗？

say:7:1321315004:1.text: Oh, yes. Some of the more perishable items have already been sent. I didn't expect you to return so soon!
say:7:1321315004:1.source_cn: 哦，是啊。那批食材里有一些容易腐坏的菜，我就让手底下的...

say:8:1321315005:1.text: Once my worker gets back, I'll have him deliver these fruits, too.
say:8:1321315005:1.source_cn: 等他回来之后，我会让他再把你们摘的这些果子送过去的。

say:11:1321315006:1.text: No need! We're heading back to the inn, we can just take them with us.
say:11:1321315006:1.source_cn: 不用啦，反正我们也要回旅店，直接带回去就好了。

say:12:1321315007:1.text: Oh, I couldn't possibly trouble you like this...

say:13:1321315008:1.text: But, since you're going that way, could I ask for a small favor? It's right along your route!
say:13:1321315008:1.source_cn: 不过既然你们要回旅店，能顺便帮我一个忙吗？正好顺路！

choice_prompt:14:1321315008.text: But, since you're going that way, could I ask for a small favor? It's right along your route!
choice_prompt:14:1321315008.source_cn: 不过既然你们要回旅店，能顺便帮我一个忙吗？正好顺路！

say:15:1321315009:1.text: The person handling the delivery this time is new. It's their first time delivering alone, and I'm a bit worried. Could you keep an eye out for them on your way back?
say:15:1321315009:1.source_cn: 这次负责运货的是个新人，头一次独自送货。我有点不放心，...

say:16:1321315010:1.text: If everything goes smoothly, great. If not... I may need to bother you again.
say:16:1321315010:1.source_cn: 要是一切顺利就再好不过了。万一出点什么事，只能再请你们...

say:17:1321315011:1.text: No problem! With the courageous Sir Chippy here, nothing bad will happen!
say:17:1321315011:1.source_cn: 小事一桩！有骑士满满在，绝对不会出事的！

choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 刚才你还说不好意思呢！

choice:14:1:2.text: Sure, I'm always down to help.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 说吧，我就喜欢助人为乐
choice:14:1:2.male: Sure, I'm always down to help.
choice:14:1:2.female: Sure, I'm always down to help.

say:0:1321316001:0.text: Is anyone nearby? Please, someone help!
say:0:1321316001:0.source_cn: 附近有没有人？谁能帮帮我？

say:1:1321316002:0.text: Could that be Varon's new employee?
say:1:1321316002:0.source_cn: 前面那个人好像是瓦迪姆的员工，该不会真的出事了吧……

say:2:1321317001:1.text: Oh, you're the guests from earlier! Thank goodness. Please, you have to help me!
say:2:1321317001:1.source_cn: 你们是刚才的客人！太好了……请一定要帮帮我！

say:3:1321317002:1.text: Calm down. Take a deep breath and tell us what's going on.
say:3:1321317002:1.source_cn: 别着急，慢慢说，究竟发生了什么事？

say:4:1321317003:1.source_cn: 是野狼！这附近有野狼出没！

say:5:1321317004:1.text: I was leading the reindeer to deliver goods to the Frozen Paw, and a pack of wolves appeared out of nowhere!
say:5:1321317004:1.source_cn: 我领着驯鹿往白熊旅店运货，原本好好走在路上……可没想到...

say:6:1321317005:1.text: The reindeer panicked and kicked at the wolves, which gave me a chance to escape. I tried to make it to the inn, but I hurt my leg and can barely move...
say:6:1321317005:1.source_cn: 驯鹿受到惊吓，踹了那些野狼好几脚，我这才趁机逃了出来。...

say:7:1321317006:1.text: I didn't know what to do until I saw you. Please, drive off those wolves and save the reindeer! If anything happens to it or the goods, Varon will never forgive me!
say:7:1321317006:1.source_cn: ——幸好遇到了你们！求求你们，帮我赶走那些野狼，救救驯...

say:10:1321317007:1.text: Where's the reindeer and the wolves now?

say:11:1321317008:1.text: You'll see them if you <style="highlight">head north along the path</style>. Oh, Dura above, please keep the reindeer safe!

say:0:1321318001:0.text: Fortunately, it looks scared but uninjured.
say:0:1321318001:0.source_cn: 幸好，驯鹿只是受了点惊吓，并没有受伤。

say:1:1321318002:0.text: Let's bring it back to the delivery worker.
say:1:1321318002:0.source_cn: 我们赶快把它带回运货的员工身边吧。

say:2:1321319001:1.text: The reindeer's fine, and the goods are intact. Thank you so much! I was sure I was going to get fired...
say:2:1321319001:1.source_cn: 驯鹿没受伤，货物也没丢……！真是太感谢你们了！我总算不...

say:3:1321319002:1.text: Forget about that, how's your leg?
say:3:1321319002:1.source_cn: 比起这个，你腿上的伤还好吗？

say:4:1321319003:1.text: I wrapped it up a bit, and I think I'm okay to walk.
say:4:1321319003:1.source_cn: 刚才简单包扎了一下，走路不成问题。

say:5:1321319004:1.text: ...Ah! I need to get these goods to the Frozen Paw immediately! If I'm late, Varon will dock my pay for sure.
say:5:1321319004:1.source_cn: ……哎呀！我得赶快把货物送到白熊旅店去才行！要是耽误了...

say:6:1321319005:1.text: We're heading there too. Let's go together.
say:6:1321319005:1.source_cn: 我们正好也要去白熊旅店，就一起过去吧。

say:2:1321321001:1.text: M-Madam Gerda! These are the ingredients you ordered from Varon. Here's the inventory list, too!
say:2:1321321001:1.source_cn: 格、格尔达女士，这些是您从瓦迪姆老板那里订的食材。对了...

say:3:1321321002:1.text: Oh, Varon never disappoints! His team always brings the best.
say:3:1321321002:1.source_cn: 瓦迪姆手上的食材种类倒是很齐全，真不愧是雪松镇最靠谱的商人。

say:4:1321321003:1.text: But... hmm. These quantities don't quite match my order.
say:4:1321321003:1.source_cn: ……嗯？怎么有一些和我订的数量对不上？是我记错了吗？

say:5:1321321004:1.text: W-well... Varon's team searched the entire Duchy, but these were all they could procure for now. The rest either weren't fresh enough or were overpriced, and the boss didn't want to raise your costs...
say:5:1321321004:1.source_cn: 是……是这样的，瓦迪姆老板派人找遍了公国，但暂时只能采...

say:6:1321321005:1.text: But don't worry, he promised to send the rest in a few days!
say:6:1321321005:1.source_cn: 不过您放心，瓦迪姆老板过几天一定会补上这些缺口！这是他...

say:7:1321321006:1.text: I see... Well, it can't be helped. This will have to do for now. Thank you for bringing it.
say:7:1321321006:1.source_cn: 唉……这也不能怪你们，暂时这样吧。

say:10:1321321007:1.text: By the way, how is your fish experiment going? Did you find any fish that can adapt to the hot spring water?
say:10:1321321007:1.source_cn: 对了，格尔达女士，你的鱼怎么样了？有没有能适应温泉环境的？

say:11:1321321008:1.text: Ah, now there's both good news and bad news.
